```python
import pytest

from your_module import title_case


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_text", "expected"),
    [
        ("hello world", "Hello World"),
        ("hELLo wORLd", "Hello World"),
        ("already Title Case", "Already Title Case"),
        ("hello, WORLD!", "Hello, World!"),
        ("NASA launch", "Nasa Launch"),
    ],
)
def test_title_case_happy_path(input_text, expected):
    assert title_case(input_text) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_text", "expected"),
    [
        ("", ""),
        ("   ", ""),
        ("  hello   world  ", "Hello World"),
        ("hello\tworld\nagain", "Hello World Again"),
        ("123ABC abc123", "123abc Abc123"),
        ("o'CONNOR smith-jONES", "O'connor Smith-jones"),
        ("éLAN mañana", "Élan Mañana"),
    ],
)
def test_title_case_edge_cases(input_text, expected):
    assert title_case(input_text) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        None,
        123,
        3.14,
        ["hello", "world"],
        {"text": "hello world"},
    ],
)
def test_title_case_raises_attribute_error_for_inputs_without_split(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        title_case(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_title_case_raises_type_error_for_bytes_input():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        title_case(b"hello world")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
```
